meta.source_of_truth: LOCAL clone corpus/dfhack_full (DFHack = community reverse-engineering of Dwarf Fortress engine)
primary_sources: docs/dev/Lua API.rst (7930 lines: wrapper semantics + world/units/items/military/modules)
plugins/fastdwarf.cpp, zone.cpp, siege-engine.cpp, preserve-rooms.cpp (relationship_ids, hf spouse links)
meta.caveat: df-structures XML submodule (library/xml) is EMPTY in this clone; field lists are reconstructed from C++/Lua accessor usage in-repo plus the Lua API doc. Fields marked confirmed = directly referenced in source. Fields marked inferred = exposed via documented API functions rather than direct field access.

wrapper_meta.note: The data model is runtime-introspectable: every named type exposes _fields (name/offset/count/mode/type_name/index_enum/ref_target), _kind, _type, pairs() over real fields in memory order, type.find()/get_vector() for instance-vector classes.
wrapper_meta.fold: any engine worth stealing exposes its own schema to its scripts

unit.description: The living, simulated creature present on the map. Flesh-level identity; links to its eternal record via hist_figure_id.

fields.id: int32 unique unit id, stable for lookups (df.unit.find)
fields.name: language_name struct (has_name, language, words[] parts-of-speech) - names are generative word data, not display strings
fields.profession: df.profession enum (accounts for false identity via API)
fields.custom_profession: player-set string label overriding profession name
fields.hist_figure_id: id of the eternal historical_figure this body is the current incarnation of
fields.flags: flagarray (flags1/2/3: on_ground, hungry, thirsty, tired, artifact-mood, etc.)

status.artifact_name: language_name PRE-NAMING the artifact the unit is destined to create in a strange mood

fields.inventory: vector of carried items with inv_item_role_type (Hauled/Worn/Weapon/StuckIn) + body_part
fields.relationship_ids: ENUM-INDEXED id map: unit_relationship_type -> unit id (PetOwner, RiderMount, Dragger, Dragee, Mother, Father, Spouse, Child, Lover...). Typed edge table, not a name field.

relations.note: further int ids for the social graph

fields.histfig_id / general_refs / specific_ref: typed links out to world graph

unit_soul.description: The psychological record, held separately from the body. One per unit (unit->status.current_soul). This is the engine's inner-life table.

fields.skills: vector of unit_skill {id: job_skill enum, rating: 0-normalized level, experience: raw xp, rustiness, last_used_timestamp} - skill decay tracked via timestamps
fields.preferences: vector of typed likes (materials, creatures, colors, foods, poetic forms...)

unit_personality.description: Stress, emotions, dreams, needs, values, beliefs, traits - the deepest inner-life structure in the engine.

fields.stress: long-term accumulated stress (confirmed Units.cpp getStressCategoryRaw uses it; 7 stress cutoff buckets 0-6)
fields.emotions: vector of personality_moodst (see below) - each an event row with cause + timestamp
fields.dreams: vector of personality_goalst {type: df.goal_type (STAY_ALIVE, CREATE_MASTERWORK...), flags.bits.accomplished: bool} - a life goal with achievement state (attrs: short_name 'Stay Alive', achieved_short_name 'Stayed Alive')
fields.needs: vector of personality_needst {id: df.need_type, need_level: intensity, focus_level: negative=deprived, deity_id, prayer/sphere} - drives that gate focus; focus penalties up to 400+ when unmet
fields.values: belief strengths per df.value_type (law, tradition, nature, craft...)

personality_moodst_emotion.description: One emotional event on a dwarf. Confirmed field-by-field in plugins/misery.cpp.

fields.thought: df.unit_thought_type - the CAUSE (SoapyBath, complained about rain, admired a fine door...)
fields.flags: bitfield (misery.cpp uses bit30 to mark synthetic emotions)
fields.year_tick: tick within year - emotions are TIMESTAMPTED

historical_figure.description: The eternal record of a person: survives death, lives in world history, referenced by units, artifacts, events. The engine tracks NPCs BEYOND their gameplay lifetime.

fields.name: language_name
fields.unit_id: live unit incarnation link (confirmed preserve-rooms.cpp spouse_hf->unit_id)
fields.profession: historic profession (can differ from fort-mode profession, e.g. Monk)
fields.info: hf->info: spheres, secrets (necromancy), skills snapshot, biography facets
fields.histfig_links: vector of typed links to OTHER figures (spouse, mother, father, child, lover, rival, master/apprentice, prisoner, hero/protector)
fields.entity_links: typed membership links to civilizations/groups (member, former member, enemy, prisoner, slave, mercenary, position claims)
fields.site_links: habitat/homeowner/seat of power links to world sites
fields.artifact links: created/holds/holds-artifact-somewhere links (general_ref IS_ARTIFACT from the artifact side)
fields.relationship via API: Units::getKillCount(unit) - kill ledger; getAge(unit, true_age) ignores false identities; getNoblePositions returns {entity, assignment, position} triples

historical_entity.description: A civilization/organization: has positions (nobility), resources, relations, its own history.

fields.positions: vector of entity_position: noble TITLES with duties (law enforcement, bookkeeping), succession rules, required links (land for holder, spouse title)
fields.assignments: entity_position_assignment: which histfig currently holds which position, with precedence
fields.resources: entity->resources (confirmed): race/caste breads, metals, items the civ produces/trades - economic fingerprint
fields.relationships: stance/rep per other civ + item/creature values for trade pricing (caravan value modifier in items.getValue)

artifact_record.description: Named unique objects with a myth-history. world.artifacts.all; resolved from an item via item.flags.bits.artifact + general_ref IS_ARTIFACT (Items.cpp).

fields.name: language_name (has_name; generated with word_table Artifact/ArtifactEvil categories per strangemood.cpp)
fields.item: the physical item it is bound to (item -> artifact, one-way body + back-ref)
fields.unit->status.artifact_name: the maker PRE-DREAMS the artifact's name before mooding (confirmed strangemood.cpp) - destiny is a stored field

fields.pos: last position ON GROUND (true position via API items.getPosition when held)
fields.flags: bitfield: artifact, owned, forbid, in_inventory, melted-designate, trade-mark (39+ flags)
fields.general_refs: TYPED EDGE VECTOR: CONTAINED_IN_ITEM, CONTAINS_ITEM, UNIT_ITEMOWNER, UNIT_HOLDER, BUILDING_HOLDER, BUILDING_CIVZONE_ASSIGNED, BUILDING_CAGED, BUILDING_CHAIN, UNIT_WORKER, IS_ARTIFACT, WRITTEN_CONTENT, PROJECTILE, UNIT_KIDNAPEE, UNIT_PATIENT, UNIT_MILKEE, UNIT_SHEAREE, UNIT_SUCKEE...
fields.improvements: decoration layers (images, rings, bands - each with own creator histfig)

building.df_type: df::building base + subclasses (workshop, bridge, cage, civzone...)

fields.relations: room adjacency graph - rooms know their neighbors (confirmed probe.cpp: 'bld->relations.size() rooms')
fields.owner: ownership via UNIT_ITEMOWNER-style refs + zone assigned_unit_id
fields.name: settable name (squad barracks etc.)

fields.job_items: required input item filters (job_item: item_type, material, quantity)
fields.general_refs: links to workshop, worker unit, items

world.description: The root container of a running world. Everything hangs off it.

fields.frame_counter: tick clock since year start (calendar: 12 months x 28 days, ReadCurrentYear/Month/Day/Tick)

history.events: APPEND-ONLY world event log (history_event_hist_figure_diedst, history_event_change_hf_moodst, history_event_remove_hf_entity_linkst...) - event-sourced world history

fields.sites.all / world_site: site records (id, name, type, civ_id owner, cur_owner_id, created_year, rgn_min/max_x/y world-coord bbox, global_min/max bbox, buildings[], subtype_info, realization - the site is ALSO simulated at two granularities)

world_data.region_map: per world-tile region_map_entry {region_id, geo_index, elevation, rainfall, drainage, savagery, evilness, vegetation, temperature, salinity, flags} - the PERSONALITY OF THE LAND as data per tile
world_data.regions: world_region records (type: df.world_region_type, weather, flowers/trees populations)

raws.language.word_table[2][category]: generated-name word banks by good/evil x name-part

language_name.description: Names are STRUCTURED DATA: words + language + form, translatable to string on demand (Translation::translateName). Uniqueness enforced per language.

fields.words[7]: dwarven-style full name = 7 word slots (front compound, rear compound, first, last, translation of first, translation of last, era)

activity.description: Social life is scheduled data: a unit's current social activity (getMainSocialActivity) is an entry containing ordered events (getMainSocialEvent returns last). 'Purple' vs 'green' socialize states gate job availability.

identity_graph.general_refs: Every object carries a vector of typed references. Reference TYPES are semantic verbs: owns, contained-in, holds, built-into, caged-in, chained-to, created, killed, kidnapped, married-to, worshiped, written-about. The graph IS the social/material world.
identity_graph.specific_refs: short-lived contextual edges (a job's target, a mandate)
identity_graph.id_spaces: separate id spaces per record class (unit, item, building, hf, entity, site, artifact, art_image, written_content, poetric_form, interaction...) all resolvable via Type.find(id) and general_ref hops

eventful/EventManager events: history_event subscriptions (eventful): react to the world-history event log as it appends
engine_event_stream.fold: the engine has a first-class event bus with per-type frequency tuning

dfhack.persistent.getSiteData/getWorldData(key[,default]): save-file-attached key-value store, scoped per site or per world
dfhack.persistent.getUnsavedSeconds(): track how stale the save is

engine_persistence.fold: the engine itself provides durable KV scoped to place and world - exactly the DataStore pattern

top_deepest_observations: 1. Emotions are timestamped rows with a causal thought enum, strength, severity, and flags - not a mood scalar. A 2006 game logs WHAT CAUSED each feeling and WHEN.
2. Dual identity: the living unit and the eternal historical_figure are separate records joined by hist_figure_id; the figure outlives the unit and accrues history. Death does not delete a person.
3. The relationship system is an enum-indexed typed edge map (unit.relationship_ids + general_refs + hf entity/site/hf links) - relations are queryable edges, never denormalized names.
4. False identity is supported at engine level: getAge(unit, true_age), getProfession 'accounting for false identity' - NPCs can lie about who they are, and the truth is still stored.

5. Destiny is stored: unit->status.artifact_name pre-names the artifact a dwarf will create; dreams[] carry accomplishment flags; needs[] carry focus_level that decays unmet. The engine tracks intention, not just behavior.
6. Names are generative word-vectors (7 word slots + parts of speech + language), not strings - any name can be decomposed and regenerated.
7. Region map entries carry evilness/savagery/drainage/rainfall per world tile - geography itself has a personality profile.
